coordinateContract.sourceEpoch: J2000 angular coordinates; cosmological radial coordinate has no positional epoch
coordinateContract.distanceConvention: Planck18 model-derived present-day line-of-sight comoving Mpc
coordinateContract.redshiftConvention: Published spectroscopic redshift for landmarks; named fixed redshift for model scale markers
coordinateContract.cosmologyAssumption: Astropy Planck18 realization, flat Lambda-CDM with massive-neutrino treatment

scope.cmbAnisotropyMap: Unavailable in Phase 4E; reserved for Phase 4F

frozenRules: Do not generate, replicate, randomize, or infer galaxies in unobserved directions.
Do not describe the particle horizon as an edge of the entire Universe.
Do not describe model-derived comoving distance or cosmic age as direct observation.
Do not display a CMB texture or anisotropy map in Phase 4E.
Keep the inner Phase 4D SDSS/BOSS footprint sparse and visibly incomplete.
